response_text:
1. (Currently amended) An airfoil for a turbine engine comprising: an airfoil having pressure and suction sides and extending in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 40-70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span, wherein the airfoil is a fan blade for a gas turbine engine.

21. (Currently amended) The airfoil according to claim 20, wherein the leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are positive, and wherein the leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are within 50 of one another. 

25. (Currently amended) The airfoil according to claim 1, wherein the airfoil is a fan blade for a gas turbine engine, and the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a leading edge dihedral and a span position, the leading edge dihedral negative from 0% span position to 100% span position. 

26. (Currently amended) A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section having an array of twenty-six or fewer fan blades, wherein the fan section has a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55; a geared architecture coupling the fan section to the turbine section or the compressor section; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 40-70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span, wherein the airfoil is a fan blade for a gas turbine engine. 

27. (Currently amended) A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section has a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 40-70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span, wherein the airfoil is a fan blade for a gas turbine engine. 

28. (Currently amended) The gas turbine engine according to claim 27, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.52, and the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip. 

29. (Currently amended) The gas turbine engine according to claim 28, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.50, and the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip. 

30. (Currently amended) The gas turbine engine according to claim 29, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.48, and the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip.
